description: This file contains test cases and helper functions for testing team management features within a software project. It uses pytest and aiohttp to perform asynchronous HTTP requests to endpoints related to user, team, and key management, including creating, updating, deleting teams and members, generating API keys, and performing chat completions. The tests focus on verifying access controls, team member management, budget enforcement, and endpoint behaviors.

methods.name: get_user_info(session, get_user, call_user, view_all: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Fetches user information from the server, with an option to filter by user ID and view permissions.

methods.name: wait_for_team_member_spend_update( session, user_id, team_id, expected_min_spend, max_wait=10 )
methods.description: Polls the user info endpoint until a specific spend update is observed or times out, ensuring asynchronous spend changes are committed.

methods.name: new_user( session, i, user_id=None, budget=None, budget_duration=None, models=["azure-models"], team_id=None, user_email=None, )
methods.description: Creates a new user via API, optionally assigning them to a team, with specified models and budget.

methods.name: add_member( session, i, team_id, user_id=None, user_email=None, max_budget=None, members=None )
methods.description: Adds a member to a team with optional max budget constraints.

methods.name: update_member( session, i, team_id, user_id=None, user_email=None, max_budget=None, )
methods.description: Updates an existing team member's information, such as max budget.

methods.name: delete_member(session, i, team_id, user_id=None, user_email=None)
methods.description: Removes a member from a team based on user ID or email.

methods.name: generate_key( session, i, budget=None, budget_duration=None, models=["azure-models", "gpt-4", "dall-e-3"], team_id=None, )
methods.description: Generates an API key associated with a team and specified models.

methods.name: chat_completion(session, key, model="gpt-4")
methods.description: Performs a chat completion request to the API using a provided key and model.

methods.name: new_team(session, i, user_id=None, member_list=None, model_aliases=None)
methods.description: Creates a new team with specified members, aliases, and models.

methods.name: update_team(session, i, team_id, user_id=None, member_list=None, **kwargs)
methods.description: Updates team attributes, such as alias and members.

methods.name: delete_team( session, i, team_id, )
methods.description: Deletes a team identified by team ID.

methods.name: list_teams( session, i, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all teams.

methods.name: get_team_info(session, get_team, call_key)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific team.
